description: ZTE modems and router modules in modem mode, USB 19d2 with serial, QMI, NCM or MBIM functions: MF821 (19d2:0167), MF28D / MF290 (0189), P685M / ZM8630A (1275), MF286 / MF286A (1432), MF286D / MF289F (1485), MF286R (1489), MF823 in NCM (1402), MF831 in MBIM (9994). ModemManager owns them. Their AT set is ZTE's: AT+ZRSSI, AT+ZCELLINFO?, AT+ZCAINFO? (no ZTE dialect in the engine yet: radio through ModemManager); the MF286D keeps SMS in storage MT. CD-ROM identities 19d2:0542 / 0548 / 0564 eject to a modem (19d2:0565) with a StandardEject rule that OpenWrt's usb-mode.json may lack: the engine switches nothing itself; a CD-ROM re-enumeration is not a power fault. The web sticks (cdc_ether / rndis only, a router inside: MF79, MF823/MF667 in RNDIS, Tenda MF6) do not match and have their own zte-web profiles. Reference only, not on our bench. Sources: another modem manager 3.5.8 modem/usb/19d2* (model names and the ZTE AT set), lib.sh (19d2:1485 SMS storage MT), usb-mode-extra.json (0542/0548/0564 StandardEject), collect.sh (19d2:1405 CD-ROM re-enumeration, live report 2026-09-08); imported catalog compositions 19d2:1402 (mf823, ncm) and 19d2:9994 (mf831, mbim); docs/modem-zoo/modems/zte-mf-family.md; docs/HANDOFF.md 126, 162
